title: The “10th Juror”: Open-Set Standpoint Screening for Bureaucratic Bias Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the MARS-Gov multi-agent framework on the Dutch Government Bias Dataset (DGDB) to measure detection accuracy (F1), mitigation success (Bias Mitigation Rate), and open-set recovery using a Leave-One-Category-Out (LOCO) test.
